shortcut.primary.title: Run Shared Action (Primary Shortcut)
shortcut.secondary.title: Run Shared Action (Secondary Shortcut)
shortcut.remark: Calls the same shared action as the other shortcut entry.
shortcut.routingMode.title: Toggle Routing Conflict Mode (Block/Ignore)
shortcut.routingMode.remark: Active only in the PCB editor; toggles the current routing conflict mode between block and ignore.
shortcut.registration.partialFailure: Some shortcuts could not be registered. See the console log.
shortcut.status.title: Shortcut Status
routingMode.busy: A routing conflict mode change is already in progress.
routingMode.apiUnavailable: The document source API is not available in this EasyEDA version.
routingMode.documentUnavailable: The current PCB document source could not be read.
routingMode.notSupported: The current document has no editable PCB routing preference.
routingMode.saveFailed: Could not write the routing conflict mode back to the document source.
routingMode.changed: Routing conflict mode changed from “${1}” to “${2}”.
routingMode.error: Could not toggle routing conflict mode: ${1}
about.title: About Multi-Shortcut Action
about.description: This extension uses two independent shortcut registrations for one shared action and adds a PCB routing conflict mode shortcut.
about.settingsHint: All three shortcuts can be changed independently in EasyEDA settings.
about.systemLimit: This extension does not override or modify EasyEDA system shortcuts.
about.betaNotice: Note: SYS_ShortcutKey and the document source read/write APIs are currently BETA APIs.
